en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.3914 - Abu Hammam wrote to Abu Al-Hasan (as) regarding a man who rented a property from another man.

The landlord then sold the property in the presence of the tenant, who did not object to the sale and witnessed it. The buyer later died, leaving heirs. The question was whether the property would revert to the heirs as inheritance or remain with the tenant until the lease period ended.
Imam (as) wrote in response: "It remains in the hands of the tenant until the lease period ends."
